definitions.coverage: V(A) / V(all eligible datasets), V = log det(I + L_A' L_A) (note Eq. 8); 1 = as informative about the shared capabilities as running all eligible datasets
definitions.resolved: 1 - posterior variance of each capability given the suite; 0 = nothing learnt, 1 = pinned down
definitions.robust: sets maximise mean coverage over B refits on subsampled GeoFMs; intervals are the 5th-95th percentile over refits
